meta.title: DSH Toolbox
meta.description: Personal tool pack: two-layer memory injection + memory write tool, see_image (vision model transcription via host LLM channel), dispatch (assembles review-form combos and ready-made briefs per batch type; at stage 方案 it emits the plan task book; its rules live in JSON read fresh on every call), and dispatch_batch (batch ledger with start/advance/status/list; state is folded from the events, the ledger lives in the machine-shared agent-data repo, and dispatch(batch=…) back-fills that batch's decision list).
